title: Universe export
note: Local and self-host move exports use --pause-source to stop writers and drain client sessions, bind one snapshot to the archive and receipt, and remain paused until explicit universe resume. A backup without the flag carries False and cannot enter hosted replacement. Hosted Prepare archive pauses only its source, with polled phases Checking access, Pausing source, Finishing active work, Exporting database, Packing archive, Uploading archive, and Archive ready; source paused. Phase status shows elapsed seconds and bytes. The completed signed link offers Download archive and Copy link with an absolute expiry time; Resume source restores the source explicitly. Import shows Fetching archive, Verifying archive, Checking destination, and Replacing universe before receipt status. Refusals and recovery stay in the active dialog; interrupted import responses recover the durable receipt before suggesting another attempt. Export completion is not destination acceptance. Artifact transfer uses caller-owned routing and an injectable S3 client factory for hosted credentials.
